title: Building a website about making games with AI, any advice?
author: Admirable-Cry270
selftext:
Hey, I just started a small site where I try AI tools for game dev and write down what actually happened, with the prompts and results.

It’s very early and I’m still figuring out what’s useful. What would you want from a site like this? And what would make you close the tab?

[https://aigamedev.ai](https://aigamedev.ai)

Any feedback is welcome, thanks!

comments.author: SolGuy
comments.body: May I suggest not to just do starting tutorials, there are so many of those kind of sites. Try complex features for existing games: how to implement coyote jump on a platformer, how to balance on a jrpg, how to properly do loot drops,...

comments.author: LegoFighter2
comments.body: Create an ingredient knowledge base. A place AI Agents can go and copy your template and how to (can be text describing technqiues)

replies.author: Admirable-Cry270
replies.body: thank you, do you think let ai summarize gdc talks would be helpful

replies.author: LegoFighter2
replies.body: No, dont do that. Choose a field field first, mmo, pixel rpg, than split them up into the different aspect that flow into the final game: How does the story stays consistent, what is story -telling and why is it important? What does good story-telling is all about? Examples... All kinds of this, what is a game mechanic, how to develop and playtest a game mechaic before starting with UI menu...

replies.author: Admirable-Cry270
replies.body: that's a better idea, things are different than pre ai era

replies.author: LegoFighter2
replies.body: imagine, all agent visit your page, because you give them good instruction (better than the vibe coders do)

replies.author: Admirable-Cry270
replies.body: that would be the dream lol

replies.author: LegoFighter2
replies.body:
you have think more structured: what is it that a LLM would love read. Which information should be abstract, which information should be more precisely instatiated. 

You can do it!

replies.author: LegoFighter2
replies.body: they will prefer you, over the ai user

replies.author: Admirable-Cry270
